title: Microsoft Teams: pinch to zoom on shared screens
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap, the updated rollout notice, the Teams licence requirement and the related sharing controls. Add a caveat that Microsoft's support article still says Mac trackpads cannot zoom in meetings, despite Mac being listed for this rollout.

claims.claim: No separate pinch-to-zoom rollout window for GCC, GCC High or DoD has been published in the checked material.
claims.quote: Searched: "576193" "GCC" "rollout"; read the roadmap record and MC1532242. The record gives one month target; the notice gives Worldwide windows only. Learn returned no feature-specific cloud schedule.

claims.claim: Screen sharing mode is reached in Teams admin center at Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Content sharing > Screen sharing mode.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
2. Select the policy that you want to edit.
3. Go to the Content sharing section.
4. Select the settings you want to use. These settings are described in the Screen sharing mode

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell supports Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -ScreenSharingMode <value> to change screen-sharing mode.
claims.quote:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy
    [[-Identity] <XdsIdentity>]
    [-ScreenSharingMode <String>]
Determines the mode in which a user can share a screen in calls or meetings.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Screen sharing mode governs whether users can share a desktop or application window in a Teams meeting.
claims.quote: The setting controls whether a user can share a desktop and window in a Teams meeting.

claims.claim: Screen sharing mode is a per-user policy applying to users assigned the policy.
claims.quote:
This setting is a per-user policy.
If your users are using Teams in a web browser and are assigned this value, this setting functions as Not enabled.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not document Screen sharing mode as a control over viewers' pinch-to-zoom.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams pinch-to-zoom shared screen admin setting PowerShell Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy. Read content-sharing policy and searched the full Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy reference for zoom. ScreenSharingMode controls sharing, with no documented viewer-zoom function.

claims.where: controls[1]; summary; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no tenant admin UI switch or API to disable pinch-to-zoom on shared screens.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "pinch-to-zoom" "disable"; Teams pinch-to-zoom shared screen admin setting PowerShell Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy. Opened content-sharing policy and searched the complete cmdlet reference for zoom; no feature-specific UI or API switch found.

claims.claim: The content-sharing policy article describes existing sharing settings and states no licence for pinch-to-zoom.
claims.quote: Searched: read the entire Manage meeting policies for content sharing article for pinch-to-zoom and its licensing. It covers Screen sharing mode, PowerPoint Live, Whiteboard, Live share and Shared notes, with no pinch-to-zoom licensing statement.

claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "pinch-to-zoom" "roles". Read roadmap, MC1532242, content-sharing policy and Support's Present content in Microsoft Teams meetings; no role requirement specific to the pinch gesture found.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified another input method that triggers this touchpad pinch gesture.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "pinch-to-zoom" "client" "touchpad". Read roadmap, notice and Support's Zoom in to shared content. Support lists trackpad pinch plus keyboard and mouse zoom alternatives, not another input that triggers the touchpad gesture.
